notes.title: Closed Beta and Steam Issues
notes.content:
Greetings D-Class personnel! 

I have just started the closed beta for Descend and cannot wait to start getting awesome feedback!

If you are having issue opening the game, so am I. For some reason Steam is not downloading the files to the computer. Hopefully, by the time you read this the issues will be resolved! If you have any questions or concerns please reach out!
